product_metadata.title: CosmoLiving by Cosmopolitan Liberty Mantel Fireplace, White Marble
features: Timeless style meets modern convenience with the Liberty Mantel Fireplace from CosmoLiving by Cosmopolitan
Perfect for the living room, den, family room, or to add ambiance to the bedroom
Faux marble veining on durable laminated MDF create a stunning neutral statement
Modern 23” electric fireplace insert adds to the elegance with its color-changing crystal ember bed and realistic color-changing flame effect
The insert can be used with or without heat to set the vibe in any weather, season or climate
description: PSA: marble is the chicest, like ever! The CosmoLiving by Cosmopolitan Liberty Mantel Fireplace in Faux Marble is THE essential statement piece your living room needs to go from lifeless to lavish! Faux marble veining on durable laminated MDF brings stunning, neutral style to your space that will uplift any kind of décor. The modern 23” electric fireplace insert adds to the elegance with its color-changing crystal ember bed and realistic color-changing flame effect. The insert can be used with or without heat to set the vibe in any weather, season or climate. SO versatile. Simply change the various flame and heat settings with the remote control or touch panel. Can someone say convenient? The insert plugs into a standard 120V outlet and heats a room up to 400 square feet. Timeless style meets modern convenience with the Liberty Mantel Fireplace. What’s not to love?
